title: Make the pin PR merge fully unattended
body:
## Summary

Makes the image-pin PR merge fully unattended.

Two manual gates remained on every bot-authored pin PR (observed on #21): (a) `pull_request` workflows on `bot/update-tools-image-*` branches queue as approval-gated `action_required` runs, and (b) `gh pr merge --auto` failed while repository auto-merge was disabled (now enabled — thanks).

Changes:

- `ci.yml` / `workflow-lint.yml`: `pull_request` ignores `bot/update-tools-image-*` branches — those runs only ever sat as `action_required`; the pin PR's required checks are produced by dispatched runs instead. `workflow-lint.yml` gains `workflow_dispatch` so the publish run can produce the required `zizmor` check on the pin branch.
- `publish-bard-images.yml`: after opening the pin PR it dispatches **both** `ci.yml` and `workflow-lint.yml` on the pin branch, requires both to succeed, then `gh pr merge --auto` enqueues the PR into the merge queue — build → pin PR → checks → merge with zero manual steps.

Behavior change: pin PRs will no longer show approval-gated CI/lint runs, and `#21`-era "Approve and run" clicks disappear.

## Related issues

None.
